company_description: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Provides in-app product insights and contextual help across B2B SaaS applications. Heavy product telemetry, user event streams, and need for low-latency developer-facing LLM features.
notes:
- Background: Product team wants integrated chatassistant + contextual doc search for customers (support and in-app help).
- Current architecture: multi-tenant service in GCP, customer data in EU and US projects. Uses Okta for SSO.
- Buying path: start with Hosted API for quick POC (proof of concept), then move to Dedicated (VPC) if security/latency/cost checks pass.
- Security asks (explicit from security review): SOC2 Type II report, SSO/SAML integration pattern, per-request audit logs, KMS/HSM key controls, retention/erase controls, EU data residency and VPC peering or private endpoint.
- Performance targets: p50 < 200ms for short chat turns, sustained 40-60 rps for embeddings pipeline (batching OK), reranking pipeline target throughput 100 qps peak.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit-cost delta vs hosted exceeds 30% savings at projected scale.
- Model preference: open/quantized models (Llama-family variants) acceptable; want fallback routing to lower-cost variants during peak.
- Quote (CTO): "We need guarantees on where data lands and audit trails we can give customers. If the security bar isn't met, we can't proceed to Dedicated."
- AE/SE notes: security questionnaire sent 2026-03-04; SE asked for nightly logs retention options and KMS integration pattern. Pricing sheet draft in Drive.
